alertEmails.description: Addresses that receive the platform alerts; empty = the sign-in address.

post.description: A correct password emails a one-time code to the admin; it does not open a session. Wrong passwords count toward the lockout (429 while locked). Asking again inside `resendAfterSeconds` does not send another code.

expiresAt.description: The emailed code stops working at this instant.

resendAfterSeconds.description: Seconds before another code is emailed.

post.description: The right code opens the session (once). Errors: `OTP_INVALID`, `OTP_EXPIRED` (401), 429 while locked. A wrong code counts toward the same lockout as a wrong password.

refreshToken.description: Rotates on every refresh and expires after the idle timeout without one.

post.description: Keeps an active session alive. A session idle for longer than `admin.sessionIdleSec` has an expired refresh token (401); reusing an old token ends the session.

refreshToken.description: Rotates on every refresh and expires after the idle timeout without one.

post.description: Revokes the refresh token. Always succeeds for a well-formed token.

patch.description: Audited. At most `ADMIN_ALERT_EMAILS_MAX` distinct addresses; an empty list sends the alerts to the sign-in address.

post.description: A wrong current password counts toward the sign-in lockout and answers 403 `CURRENT_PASSWORD_INVALID` (not 401, so the panel keeps the session); 429 while locked. The new password is at least 12 characters and differs from the current one (422 `VALIDATION_ERROR`). Every session of the admin ends: sign in again.

post.summary: Step 1 of an email change: code to the new address
post.description: Needs the current password (same lockout rules, 403 `CURRENT_PASSWORD_INVALID`). The new address must be free (409 `EMAIL_ALREADY_USED`). A code is emailed to the NEW address; nothing changes until step 2.

expiresAt.description: The emailed code stops working at this instant.

post.summary: Step 2 of an email change: confirm the code
post.description: The right code (once, 5 minutes) changes the sign-in email and ends every session. Errors: 422 `OTP_INVALID` / `OTP_EXPIRED`; a wrong code counts toward the lockout (429 while locked); 409 `EMAIL_ALREADY_USED` if the address was taken meanwhile.
